# id: PG-pg-88-balance-chances
# covers: PG 196-198 (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Avarek + Beaks)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 36D7474D+ (pg_statprobe), harness c5a5c88+ (give artifacts, research start any; 90a0e33: teleport moved=/bed, speed hold; 6933d0f: fill topup, drop all; 616121b: benches near; c4fa520: pin, d91fe88: face) (KAH 24: chance, detect, detecttime, healtime, findwater, swimtime, construct, construction); client kah.py from the harness repo (LONG_COMMANDS has the KAH 24 timers); set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest
# design: the game's own chance functions read by the harness `chance` command (no randomness: one read per
#   point, the skill-50 no-gear point read twice): lockpick a Prisoner Cage (196), stealth KO (197) and
#   steal Iron Plates (198) against a neutral dummy (Hungry Bandit, Drifters, renamed PGTarget) 3 m
#   away, Beaks sneaking; the whole file runs paused (speed 0), so nobody moves or fights. Skills 10/25/50/75/90 without gear, then gear own2/own5/own10/own25/own50/own100/lab50 at 50.
# verify: chance rises with the skill; ownN > none = the chance reads the hooked stat; lab50 = none.
#   Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv; python3 tools/analyze_balance.py balance.csv
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 4
speed 0
protect Avarek on
protect Beaks on
health Beaks 100
health Avarek 100
blood Beaks 100%
blood Avarek 100%
hunger Beaks 280
hunger Avarek 280
select Beaks
clearjobs Beaks
pg_statprobe on Beaks
wake Avarek
pin Avarek ~ pinned
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks building "Prisoner Cage" dist 4 radius 1000 ~ moved=1
pin Avarek off ~ unpinned
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 8 ~ moved=1
pin Avarek ~ pinned
@set TGT spawn "Hungry Bandit" Drifters near Beaks dist 40 count 1 ~ spawned 1/1 [^:]+: .+? (#\d+(?:/\d+)?)
setname ${TGT} PGTarget
relation PGTarget 0
give PGTarget "Iron Plates" 2
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Beaks dist 3 ~ moved=1
stealth Beaks on
give Beaks "Iron Hat" 1
equip Beaks "Iron Hat"
pg_info Beaks "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
# --- 196 lockpicking: skill 10, gear none ---
setstat Beaks lockpicking 10
pg_clear Beaks ~ cleared affixes
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Beaks dist 3 ~ moved=1
stat Beaks lockpicking ~ wounds=1\.0000
@set C chance Beaks lockpick "Prisoner Cage" ~ lockpick_chance=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,196,lockpicking,10,0,none,s10,chance,0,${C},-
pg_statprobe read
# --- 196 lockpicking: skill 25, gear none ---
setstat Beaks lockpicking 25
pg_clear Beaks ~ cleared affixes
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Beaks dist 3 ~ moved=1
stat Beaks lockpicking ~ wounds=1\.0000
@set C chance Beaks lockpick "Prisoner Cage" ~ lockpick_chance=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,196,lockpicking,25,0,none,s25,chance,0,${C},-
pg_statprobe read
# --- 196 lockpicking: skill 50, gear none ---
setstat Beaks lockpicking 50
pg_clear Beaks ~ cleared affixes
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Beaks dist 3 ~ moved=1
stat Beaks lockpicking ~ wounds=1\.0000
@set C chance Beaks lockpick "Prisoner Cage" ~ lockpick_chance=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,196,lockpicking,50,0,none,s50,chance,0,${C},-
pg_statprobe read

pg_statprobe read
# --- 196 lockpicking: skill 50, gear own2 ---
setstat Beaks lockpicking 50
pg_clear Beaks ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Beaks "Iron Hat" lockpicking 2 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Beaks lockpicking ~ equipped_bonus=2% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Beaks dist 3 ~ moved=1
stat Beaks lockpicking ~ wounds=1\.0000

@echo BAL2,196,lockpicking,50,2,own2,own2,chance,0,${C},-
pg_statprobe read

pg_bonus Beaks thievery ~ equipped_bonus=100% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Beaks dist 3 ~ moved=1
stat Beaks thievery ~ wounds=1\.0000
@set C chance Beaks steal PGTarget item "Iron Plates" ~ steal_chance=([-\d.]+)
@echo BAL2,198,thievery,25,100,own100,s25_own100,chance,0,${C},-
pg_statprobe read
stealth Beaks off
@until 30 teleport PGTarget Beaks dist 300 ~ moved=1
kill PGTarget
